home.title: I'm Maxwell
home.description: I build web and mobile apps with React, Next.js, React Native, and Node. The parts I enjoy most are the architecture calls and the performance work: figuring out why something's slow, then making it fast.

dotcodeSenior.description: Leading frontend architecture and scaling the team's delivery capability through reusable foundations.
points: Acting as the frontend technical reference — guiding best practices, architectural decisions, and mentoring other developers.
Built a React component and template library with CI/CD, cutting new-project setup from ~8h to 30min and improving maintainability.

vivo.description: Delivered platform engineering for support teams at one of Brazil's largest telcos.
points: Built an internal low-code platform letting support teams author ServiceNow incident automations, automating 20–50% of incidents in managed queues.
Fixed a login issue blocking ~15% of users from new devices by enforcing single-device access with real-time session invalidation on login and session validation at app startup.

dotcodeFrontend.description: Owned frontend performance, tooling, and build pipeline for a customer-facing product.
points: Reduced frontend build time by ~70% (from ~30 to ~8 minutes) by migrating from Webpack to Vite and eliminating unused dependencies and dead code.
Cut app load time from ~2.5s to ~800ms by implementing code splitting and optimizing imports for more efficient tree shaking, shrinking the bundle.

gbAgritech.description: Drove frontend architecture on an agribusiness ERP.
points: Proposed and led the frontend migration of an ERP from Next.js to Vite — SSR added little value for a client-centric app — improving maintainability and cutting build time by ~30%.

vyaDigital.description: First full-stack role — shipping across the stack on consumer-facing apps.
points: Eliminated performance degradation in a chat app by implementing message-list virtualization, keeping performance consistent regardless of message volume.

footer.headline: Let's build something <emphasis>worth shipping.</emphasis>
footer.description: Open to senior full-stack roles, architecture consulting, and projects that deserve real attention to performance and detail.
footer.craftedWith: Crafted with Next.js, Tailwind, and a lot of GSAP.
